messages.subject: Error in inla.collect.dic
parts:
Hi Harvard,

I'm having an issue when running a GLS in INLA. 

I get the following when I run my model:

Error in inla.collect.dic(results.dir, debug) : 
  object 'fam.dic.sat' not found

The model is;

N <- nrow(meanRes)
Y <- matrix(NA, nrow = N, ncol = 2)
Y[meanRes$season == "July", 1] <- meanRes$meanRes[meanRes$season == "July"]
Y[meanRes$season == "October", 2] <- meanRes$meanRes[meanRes$season == "October"]

colnames(Y) <- c("July",
                 "October")
Y

M2a <- inla(Y ~ season + life_stage + recv + rSite + f(tagID, model = "iid", hyper = priorpc) + f(yday, model = "ar1", hyper = priorpc, replicate = tagID2),
           family = c("gaussian", "gaussian"),
           control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE), 
           control.family = list(list(hyper = priorpc),
                                 list(hyper = priorpc)),
           quantiles = c(0.025, 0.975),             
           control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
           data = meanRes)

Thanks in advance

Brittany
